subject.title: fix(usage): show provider quota in usage footer

question: Should `/usage` reply footers perform a 2500 ms bounded provider-usage lookup during final reply delivery, or should this feature wait for cached/preloaded quota state?
rationale: The implementation is focused and proof-backed, but it intentionally moves provider/auth probing into a final reply path where latency and omit-on-timeout behavior require product ownership.

options.title: Accept Bounded Lookup After Docs
options.body: Restore the token-use docs and land the current design if maintainers accept that cold quota lookups may omit quota text after the timeout while preserving the base usage footer.

options.title: Require Cached Quota State
options.body: Ask for the footer to use warmed or cached provider usage snapshots so final reply delivery never initiates a quota probe.

options.title: Keep Quota In Status Only
options.body: Decline inline quota footers and leave `/status` or `openclaw status --usage` as the provider quota surface.

recommendation.title: Accept Bounded Lookup After Docs
recommendation.body: Restore the token-use docs and land the current design if maintainers accept that cold quota lookups may omit quota text after the timeout while preserving the base usage footer.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest history in the provider-usage/status seam and prior issue scoping for this exact behavior.
